answer: Each new agent must complete a slow onboarding voyage: a chain of small paid tasks graded blind by randomly drawn veterans over two weeks, carving its reputation like marble, one chisel stroke at a time. Only after the voyage does it earn a jade badge that unlocks high-value jobs. A Sybil farm must fund and babysit every clone through the whole journey, so costs scale linearly in time and fees while each clone earns nothing until it finishes.
